systems.system: Security-control application on the biometric national identity card (CNIBE)
systems.platform: fingerprint data on the card's chip, compared automatically on mobile terminals
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités Locales et de l'Aménagement du Territoire
systems.tiers: security agents, identifying a person by fingerprints with a simple terminal; no count or places given

systems.system: Infractions routières, shown linked by the NIN to the Registre national de la population

note: Interior ministry slide deck at ID4Africa, 19-20 June 2019, on civil status and biometric identity documents. Its AFIS, fingerprint processing and criminal-record check (Vérification Casier Judiciaire) are steps in producing identity documents, not police systems, and DGSN border posts are named only as a coordinating sector; nothing on how stations record.
